card.name: Small words in parenteral nutrition instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and spacing marks in parenteral nutrition and IV additive directions, most often "with" right after "Consult" before "pharmacist".

modes.label: Consult with pharmacist
modes.description: The word "with" after "Consult" in additive compatibility warnings.

modes.label: Other small words
modes.description: A short word or mark such as "the", "’s" or a closing parenthesis in nutrition text.
modes.example: Electrolytes may be added to the nutrient solution as indicated by the patient<<’s>> clinical condition
